content.value: Find the particular solution for deflection $U ( x , y , t )$ of the square membrane (16) with $\pmb { a } = \pmb { b } = 1$ and c =1. If the initial velocity is zero and initial deflection is $f ( x , y ) = A$ sin πsin 2πy, where general deflection of above membrane is $U ( x , y , t ) = \sum _ { n = 1 } ^ { \infty } \sum _ { m = 1 } ^ { \infty } A _ { m n } \cos k _ { m n } t$ sin mπxsin nπy . Finally find deflection U(0.5,0.5,t).
